source_frontmatter.name: travel-planning
source_frontmatter.description: Plan trips, build itineraries, research destinations, estimate budgets, and organize logistics for Mick's travel. Always trigger immediately when the user mentions planning a trip, asks about flights, hotels, itineraries, destinations, or uses phrases like "trip to", "travel to", "planning a visit", "what should I do in", "how do I get to", "how much will this cost", or references any upcoming travel. Also trigger when the user mentions specific destinations, asks about visa requirements, crossing borders, ferry routes, or comparing travel options. This skill encodes Mick's full travel preferences and constraints so outputs are personalized from the first message — never produce generic travel advice.
